typeBlock.description: This GDDI type is used to indicate that a space vehicle command has been released at a certain point in the ground system, e.g. transmitted from the modem or released to a crypto.

tlv.description: Identifier used to match command requests and command acknowledgements. (Default: 0)
Ack Status: (0: Command was successfully released, 1: Command arrived too late to be released on time, 2: Command not dequeued in time to be released). (Default: 0)
Time that this command was released by the uplink transmitter. This represents the number of non-leap seconds elapsed since 00:00:00 UTC on 1 January 1970. (Default: 0)
The number of picoseconds representing the fractional portion of the 'Timestamp Seconds' metadata. (Default: 0)
